desc:
✈️💥 Fly planes, shoot, bomb and CRASH into EVERYTHING!

Plane Crash Physics is a sandbox where everything breaks. Blow up buildings, bridges, trains, cars, boats and tanks, shoot down airliners and helicopters, and smash your plane into hundreds of pieces!

🔥 FEATURES
✈️ 10 planes, from the Lil Prop to the Strike Jet
💣 Guns, bombs, homing rockets and NUKES
🏙️ Destroy a whole city, every part breaks!
⚔️ PvP dogfights (turn it on or off)
💰 Earn Cash for everything you destroy
🏆 Leaderboards for Parts, Money and Kills

🎮 CONTROLS
Mouse: aim • Click: shoot • Space: bomb • W/S: speed • E: bail out
📱 Works on phone and tablet too!

👥 Join Slop Cannon for the Slop Cannon Plane!
👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for more updates!
